programme.title: Mundial 2026: Uruguay - Cabo Verde
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: Buenos días América
programme.desc: Durante el Mundial, este espacio toma el pulso a todo lo acontecido en Norteamérica en la gran cita de Selecciones del año. Las mejores imágenes de los partidos y el análisis para empezar el día informado de lo que ha acontecido durante la madrugada.

programme.title: Stories From The Cities
programme.desc: Un espacio que recorre las ciudades sede de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá. En lugar de enfocarse únicamente en los estadios, el show explora la cultura local, la gastronomía, la música, la gente y el arraigo del fútbol base (fútbol comunitario) en cada una de ellas.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Arabia Saudita
programme.desc: El Mundial más grande de la historia ya está aquí. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA cuenta por primera vez con 48 equipos en busca de la gloria. Estados Unidos, México y Canadá se convierten en el epicentro del planeta fútbol del 11 de junio al 19 de julio.

programme.title: La Dazoneta
programme.desc: El equipo de La Dazoneta se pone en modo Mundial. Un análisis de todo lo que acontezca en la gran cita del verano, la Copa Mundial de la FIFA.

programme.title: Mundial - Highlights del día
programme.desc: Un repaso rápido a los mejores momentos del Mundial.

programme.title: Armando la Mundial
programme.desc: Armando la Mundial.

programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Resúmenes Mundial
programme.desc: Los encuentros del Mundial 2026 comprimidos en pocos minutos para no perderse nada de lo que ocurra en la cita de Estados Unidos, México y Canadá.

programme.title: Trending Mundial
programme.desc: El Mundial es tendencia. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA es, sin duda, el torneo global más seguido del planeta y, por tanto, deja momentos muy comentados.

programme.title: Simeone. Revelado
programme.desc: El entrenador argentino del Atlético de Madrid se ha convertido en una pieza clave para plantar batalla al Real Madrid y FC Barcelona. Descubre su lado más personal en esta entrevista con DAZN.

programme.title: Revelado - Julián Álvarez
programme.desc: El jugador argentino ha aterrizado de pie en el Atlético de Madrid y se ha convertido en una pieza clave.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Norway v France
programme.desc: Norway v France (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the final match in Group I for both teams, held at Boston Stadium in the USA. This is the first meeting between the nations since 2014, when France prevailed 4-0 in a friendly. The French are likely to go into this fixture as favourites to win once again, but a closer contest is anticipated. Should they both be available, the game could see two of the world's leading forwards go head to head in Frenchman Kylian Mbappe and Norway's Erling Haaland, and it would be little surprise if either one of them proved to be the difference-maker this evening.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Live: Quick Pitch
programme.desc: Sometimes, fans of America's national pastime might miss a day or two of their favorite sport due to pesky things like work, a wedding anniversary, or a child's high-school graduation ceremony. Rest easy, devotees of the diamond -- MLB Network has you covered. "Quick Pitch" not only provides complete highlights of each game from the previous day, but also presents a glimpse at upcoming contests, including pitching matchups.

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Baseball
programme.desc: From Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Fla.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Hurricanes visit T-Mobile Arena to play the Golden Knights in Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final. The series remains tied after the Hurricanes orchestrated a wild third-period comeback, capped off by a Seth Jarvis power-play game-winner in overtime.

programme.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Golden Knights host the Hurricanes for Game 4 of the Stanley Cup Final. Vegas reclaimed the series lead after a 5-4 double-overtime win in Game 3, fueled by Mitch Marner's hat trick. Shea Theodore scored the winner after a late Carolina rally.

programme.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights and Carolina Hurricanes meet in Game 5 of the Stanley Cup Final. Hurricanes rely on Captain Jordan Staal after his iconic two goals in Game 4, while Vegas relies on forward Mitch Marner on the road. This series is tied 2-2.

programme.title: 2026 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights and Carolina Hurricanes meet in Game 6 of the Stanley Cup Final. The visiting Hurricanes protect a 4-2 series edge behind goalie Brandon Bussi's 23 saves from Game 5, while Vegas counters with sharp offense on home ice.

programme.title: Breaking Down Barriers
programme.desc: Herb Carnegie is regarded by many as the best black player to never reach the NHL. His legacy transcends the confines of the rink, inspiring generations with his resilience and unwavering passion for the game.

programme.title: Breaking Down Barriers
programme.desc: On January 18, 1958, Willie O'Ree made history with the Boston Bruins as the first black player to skate in a National Hockey League game. O'Ree went on to play professional hockey for 21 years, shattering a barrier that had stood for over 40 years and inspiring generations of young athletes to pursue their dreams. Willie didn't just play the game, he changed it forever.
